name: Gwynant Pinball
subtitle: A quiet table, no ads
promotionalText: A calm pinball table: catch the stars, clear the targets and see how far you get. Play Gentle for endless balls or Classic for a high score. No ads, ever.
description:
A pinball table that keeps things calm.

Catch the stars that appear around the table to clear each stage. From stage two, knock down the drop targets too. Every stage brings a little more to do.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Gentle: endless balls, stage after stage, for when you just want to play
• Classic: three balls and a best score to beat, with an extra ball for every stage you clear

MADE FOR PLAYING
• Smooth physics that keep up with your screen
• Tap either side of the screen to flip
• A ball save on every ball

CALM BY DESIGN
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no tracking. Ever.
• Light and dark themes that follow your device
• Soft, optional sounds and gentle haptics
• Your game is saved the moment you leave

Gwynant games are free and open source, made with care in the spirit of Llyn Gwynant: quiet, simple and unhurried.
